name: Kabe ni Hamatte Ugokenai!
original_name: 壁にはまってうごけない!
source:
Kawabe Rio, the young girl with the slightly empty head.
She somehow decided climbing through a narrow hole in the wall would be a good shortcut. Now she's utterly stuck!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE115613.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
川边莉央是个有点迷糊的女孩。
不知怎么的，她竟觉得钻过墙上的狭窄洞口是条好捷径。现在，她彻底卡住了！

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE115613.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
